notes: Family page: the page states these styles apply to all LSB Industries brands, so the shared style is encoded in full in this file (no usesStylesOf — this IS the family page). HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (K111300076: year = first letter, chart-only, so no year encodable from text; its week is additionally ambiguous — character counting gives week 11, digit-only counting gives week 13 — but that is moot without a year). Page Style 2 ships YEAR-ONLY: year digits text-verified, month = 3rd character letter, chart-only.

styles.notes: Year = 1st & 2nd numerical digits (normalized positions [0,2] -> '92'). Month = 3rd character letter, chart-only, so year-only.
